description:
You’re locked in Alcatraz with a stolen spoon... so you build the escape, one step at a time.
A drill from a vacuum cleaner motor, a cardboard decoy, a dummy head made of soap and real hair, a raft made of 50 raincoats, and an accordion turned into a pump.
Based on the real 1962 escape of Frank Morris and the Anglin brothers. Alcatraz means “pelican island”.
